summary: TrustCo Bank Corp NY filed an 8-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting and a compensation plan amendment. Shareholders approved increasing shares under the 2019 Equity Incentive Plan by 500,000 to 1,200,000 and elected directors. No extraordinary corporate event, such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign, is present. The filing covers routine director elections, equity plan modifications, and shareholder votes, which are standard governance matters. Therefore, this is not a special situation.
